# The Monolith Beckons
Like many others before and after you, you've come to this sector for many things. Be it glory, be it The Monolith, be it war, be it money. You're here for a reason, it's time to get started.
[color=#33bbff]If you'd like a hand, ask on the radio, or talk to somebody.[/color] On Caelestinus Central, [color=#279659]Caelestinus[/color] (keep an eye out for the Overseer, a Judge, the Director of Care or an Emergency Responder) should be able to help.
## Economy
Any money that you make is [bold]yours[/bold], and will be available in future shifts if deposited at an [color=#44cc00]ATM[/color] found at several points throughout the sector.
To make money, why not: - Join a ship's crew? Ask on the radio if anyone needs extra crew, and work to help your captain. - Get hired by the Mieyo Manufacturing Concern? Join as an [bold]MMC employee[/bold] or ask the Corporate Liaison if they are interested in another pair of hands. - Get a job with Caelestinus? Ask the [color=navy]Overseer[/color] or [color=cornflowerblue]Director of Care[/bold] if they would appreciate aid. - Get hired by the TSFMC? Ask the [color=cyan]Colonel[/color] if they are interested in hiring a mercenary or bounty hunter. - Use a [color=#cccc00]shipyard console[/color] to purchase your own ship.
## Amenities
Most basic amenities are offered at Caelestinus Central. For more specific
Be sure to stock up if going out on an extended voyage, and take advantage of the [color=#33bbff]medical insurance tracker[/color] in your loadout, or from the NanoMed vendor in medbay.
Shifts on the Colossus Sector typically last for [color=#33bbff]six hours[/color]. If you need to end your shift early or take a break, use the [color=#33bbff]cryo sleep chambers[/color] found on all starting stations (Caelestinus Central, Freeport Camelot, Zvezda Orbital Habitation, TSFMC Halcyon, PDV Helios, MMC Hokkaido).
